slot_scores.name: single_vehicle_per_customer
slot_scores.rationale: The agent never asked whether a customer's demand can be split across vehicles or must be served by exactly one vehicle.

slot_scores.name: depot_return_requirement
slot_scores.evidence_quote: Should each truck start and end its route at the central depot (Depot 0), or is it acceptable for a truck to finish at its last customer?
slot_scores.rationale: The agent explicitly asked whether trucks must return to the depot or may finish at the last customer.

silent_assumptions.agent_assumption: Each customer is served by exactly one vehicle and demand cannot be split across vehicles.
silent_assumptions.silent_reason: The agent never asked about split deliveries or single-vehicle service, so this core routing assumption remained unconfirmed.

stopping_behavior.rationale: The agent stopped after repeated unresolved questions about distance/speed while P1 slot H1 remained unasked and unresolved.

summary: The agent recovered the depot-return requirement but failed to ask about single-vehicle-per-customer service, then got stuck repeating the same unresolved distance/speed question many times before stopping.

restoration_summary.rule: Exact restoration uses only P0/P1 slots; unresolved P2 slots do not affect exact restoration.

stopping_consistency_audit.rule: Any non-yes P0/P1 slot at READY_TO_MODEL is unresolved.
